idea-plugin.name: MAUI iOS Submission Gate
idea-plugin.description:
Reads a .NET MAUI app's iOS Info.plist and Entitlements.plist and names every App Store Review 5.1.1(i) purpose-string rejection and export-compliance defect before the build is uploaded.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → MAUI iOS Submission Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/maui-ios-submission-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/maui-ios-submission-gate

action.text: MAUI iOS Submission Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run MAUI iOS Submission Gate on the file in the editor
